INVITATION TO BID FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF MIAGAO
WEST CENTRAL ELEM. SCHOOL WATER SYSTEM,
MIAGAO, ILOILO
1. The Municipality of Miagao through the Budget for the Contract Approved by the
Sanggunian, Trust Fund - Provincial Aid, Budget Year 2018 intends to apply the sum
of P 300,850.00 being the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) to payments under
the contract for Supply and Delivery of Materials and Supplies for the Construction of
Miagao West Central Elem. School Water System, Miagao, Iloilo. Bids received in
excess of the ABC shall be automatically rejected at bid opening.
2. The Municipality of Miagao now invites bids for the following:
ITEM NO. | QUANTITY | UNIT ITEM DESCRIPTION
1 17 pes | 1.0m @ x 0.45 RC pipes
2 30 bags | portland cement
5) 7.5 cum | screened gravel
4 3.5 cu.m__| washed sand
5 26 pcs | 10mm @ x 6.0 RSB
6 3 pcs 3/16" thk x 1 1/2" x 11/2" x 6m angle bar
7 2 shts_ | 0.4mm x 3' x 8' plain GI sheet
8 50 pcs 3/16"@ c 1/2" blind rivets
9 Z pcs 500m roof sealant
10mm@ x 2 1/2" stainless steel bolt w/ nut
10 4 pcs _| &washer
11 1 pc fabricated door lock (barrel type)
12 1 pe 2" padlock
13 2 pcs 2' x 3" brass hinge
14 1 gal red oxide primer
15 13 kgs #18 G.l tie wire
